title: ЭЕШ English mock 2020 · Mock 1
subject: English
theme: Everyday life, storms and a summer camp interview
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences and choose the correct answer for each gap. /12*1=12/

questions.stem: I need ___ advice about choosing a university.
questions.explanation: “advice” (зөвлөгөө) тоологдохгүй нэр үг тул “an”, “a”, “many”, “few” түүнтэй хэрэглэгдэхгүй; тоологдохгүй нэр үгийн өмнө “some” орж “some advice” (хэдэн зөвлөгөө) болно.

questions.stem: We always have a big family dinner ___ New Year's Eve.
questions.explanation: Тодорхой нэг өдөр, баярын өдрийн өмнө “on” угтвар үг ордог тул “on New Year's Eve” (Шинэ оны өмнөх орой) гэнэ; “in” нь сар, жил, улиралд, “at” нь цагийн агшинд хэрэглэгдэнэ.

questions.stem: My father goes to work ___ bus every day.
questions.explanation: Ямар унаагаар явдгийг артикльгүйгээр “by” угтвар үгээр илэрхийлдэг: “by bus”, “by car”; “on” хэрэглэвэл “on the bus” гэж артикльтай байх ёстой.

questions.stem: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It is forbidden.
questions.explanation: “It is forbidden” (хориотой) гэсэн нь хориглолыг заадаг тул “mustn't” (…-ж болохгүй) орно; “don't have to”, “needn't” нь шаардлагагүй гэсэн утгатай тул хориглол илэрхийлэхгүй.

questions.stem: Bataa is ___ at drawing than his brother.
questions.explanation: Өгүүлбэрт “than” байгаа тул харьцуулах зэрэг хэрэгтэй: “good”-ийн харьцуулах зэрэг “better” бөгөөд өмнө нь “much” нэмж “much better” (хамаагүй сайн) гэж хүчирхэгжүүлнэ; “the best” нь хамгийн дээд зэрэг.

questions.stem: Listen! Somebody ___ at the door, and the dog ___.
questions.explanation: “Listen!” гэдэг нь яг одоо болж буй үйлд анхаарал хандуулж байгаа тул хоёр үйлд хоёуланд нь одоо үргэлжилж буй цаг (Present Continuous) хэрэглэж “is knocking / is barking” гэнэ.

questions.stem: My grandparents ___ live in a ger, but now they ___ in an apartment.
questions.explanation: Өмнө нь байнга байсан, одоо больсон байдлыг “used to + үйл үг” илэрхийлдэг; “but now” гэсэн тул хоёр дахь хоосон зайд одоо энгийн цаг орж “used to / live” болно.

questions.stem: She wants to become ___ astronaut and travel to ___ Mars.
questions.explanation: “astronaut” эгшиг авиагаар эхэлдэг тул “an” артикль авна, харин “Mars” зэрэг гаригийн нэрийн өмнө артикль хэрэглэдэггүй тул “an / ___” зөв.

questions.stem: Tuya enjoys ___ novels in her free time.
questions.explanation: “enjoy” үйл үгийн дараа герунд (-ing хэлбэр) ордог тул “enjoys reading” (унших дуртай) гэнэ; “to reading”, “read” хэлбэр энэ үйл үгтэй хэрэглэгдэхгүй.

questions.stem: The children made the cake ___. Nobody helped ___.
questions.explanation: Хүүхдүүд хэний ч тусламжгүй өөрсдөө хийснийг эргэх төлөөний үг “themselves” онцолно; “Nobody helped” өгүүлбэрийн өгүүлэгдэхүүн өөр тул тусагдахуун төлөөний үг “them” орж “themselves / them” болно.

questions.stem: Nobody likes waiting, ___?
questions.explanation: “Nobody” сөрөг утгатай тул хавсралт асуулт (question tag) эерэг хэлбэртэй байх ба “nobody”-г “they” гэж орлуулдаг; “likes” одоо энгийн цагт байгаа тул “do they” болно.

questions.stem: This castle ___ in the 14th century.
questions.explanation: Цайзыг хэн нэгэн барьсан, “in the 14th century” гэж өнгөрсөн хугацааг заасан тул өнгөрсөн энгийн цагийн үйлдэгдэх хэв (passive) “was built” (баригдсан) орно.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and select the correct answer for each blank. /4*2=8/

questions.stem: "I will call you tomorrow," Anu told me. Anu told me that ___.

options.A: she will calls me the next day.
options.C: I would call her the next day.
options.E: she would call me the next day.

questions.explanation: Шууд бус яриа болгоход “will” нь “would” болж, “I” нь “she”, “you” нь “me”, “tomorrow” нь “the next day” болж өөрчлөгддөг тул “she would call me the next day”.

questions.stem: If I ___ how to swim, I ___ you to the lake.
questions.explanation: Усанд сэлж чаддаггүй, одоогийн бодит бус нөхцөлийг 2-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэрээр илэрхийлнэ: “If” хэсэгт өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг, гол хэсэгт “would + үйл үг” орох тул “knew / would take”.

questions.stem: We stayed indoors ___ the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: “the heavy rain” нь үйл үггүй нэр үгийн хэллэг тул шалтгааныг “because of” (…-аас болж) гэж холбоно; “because”, “although” хоёрын дараа өгүүлэгдэхүүн, үйл үгтэй бүтэн өгүүлбэр шаардлагатай.

questions.stem: This is the house ___ my grandfather was born.
questions.explanation: “the house” гэсэн газрыг тодотгож, өвөө тэнд төрсөн гэсэн утга илэрхийлж байгаа тул газрын харьцангуй үг “where” (= “in which”) орно; “which” бол төгсгөлд нь “in” угтвар үг шаардана.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Identify one underlined part that should be corrected in the sentences. Underlined parts are marked [A ...], [B ...] and so on. /3*2=6/

questions.stem: My sister [A have] [B lived] [C in] Seoul [D since] [E 2020].
questions.explanation: Өгүүлэгдэхүүн “My sister” 3-р бие, ганц тоо тул одоо төгссөн цагт “have” биш “has lived” гэх ёстой; “since 2020” нь одоо төгссөн цагийг зөв заажээ.

questions.stem: The [A children] [B was] playing [C happily] [D in] the [E park].
questions.explanation: “The children” нь “child”-ийн олон тоо тул туслах үйл үг “was” биш “were” байх ёстой: “The children were playing happily in the park”.

questions.stem: I [A have] [B never] [C saw] [D such] a [E big] dog.
questions.explanation: “have never” гэсэн одоо төгссөн цаг “have + III хэлбэр” бүтэцтэй тул өнгөрсөн энгийн цагийн “saw” биш, III хэлбэр “seen” орж “I have never seen” болно.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and complete the gaps with the most appropriate word. /9*2=18/

questions.stem: Can you buy two ___ milk on your way home?
questions.explanation: Сүүг цаасан хайрцгаар савладаг тул “two cartons of milk” (хоёр хайрцаг сүү) гэнэ; “loaves of” нь талх, “bunches of” нь баглаа цэцэг, “slices of” нь зүсэм талх, бялуунд хэрэглэгдэнэ.

questions.stem: She has ___ hair that falls in soft waves down her back.
questions.explanation: “falls in soft waves” (зөөлөн долгиолон унждаг) гэсэн нь “wavy” (долгионтой) үсийг заана; “straight” нь шулуун, “spiky” нь шовх босгосон, “bald” нь халзан гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: Bilguun is a(n) ___ person; he loves meeting new people and talking at parties.
questions.explanation: “he loves meeting new people and talking at parties” гэсэн нь шинэ хүнтэй амархан танилцдаг “outgoing” (нийтэч, нээлттэй) зантайг харуулна; “shy”, “reserved”, “quiet” нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: The earthquake ___ hundreds of buildings in the city.
questions.explanation: Газар хөдлөлт барилгуудыг нурааж сүйтгэдэг тул “destroyed” (сүйтгэсэн) тохирно; “erupted” нь галт уул дэлбэрэх, “broke out” нь гал, дайн гарах, “melted” нь мөс хайлахыг хэлнэ.

questions.stem: Penicillin was ___ by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
questions.explanation: Пенициллин байгальд угаас байсан бодис бөгөөд Александр Флеминг түүнийг олж нээсэн тул “discovered” (нээсэн) орно; “invented” нь урьд байгаагүй шинэ зүйл, төхөөрөмж зохион бүтээхийг хэлдэг.

questions.stem: The suspect ___ that he had broken the window. He said he was at home all evening.
questions.explanation: “He said he was at home all evening” гэсэн нь сэжигтэн цонх хагалснаа “denied” (үгүйсгэсэн) болохыг харуулна; “admitted” нь хүлээн зөвшөөрсөн гэсэн эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: We use a(n) ___ at the end of a direct question.
questions.explanation: Шууд асуултын төгсгөлд “question mark” (асуултын тэмдэг) тавина; “full stop” нь цэг, “comma” нь таслал, “exclamation mark” нь анхаарлын тэмдэг.

questions.stem: We could hear the ducks ___ on the lake.
questions.explanation: Нугасны дууг “quacking” (ганганах) гэж нэрлэдэг; “roaring” нь арслангийн архирах, “buzzing” нь зөгийн дүнгэнэх, “hissing” нь могойн исгэрэх, “barking” нь нохойн хуцах дуу.

questions.stem: ___ is when someone uses the internet to hurt, threaten or embarrass another person.
questions.explanation: Интернэтээр дамжуулан бусдыг гомдоох, сүрдүүлэх, ичээхийг “Cyberbullying” (цахим дээрэлхэл) гэнэ; “Streaming”, “Blogging”, “Downloading” нь интернэтийн энгийн хэрэглээ.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Complete the sentences with the correct particle of the phrasal verbs. /4*2=8/

questions.stem: Our car ran ___ petrol in the middle of the desert.
questions.explanation: “run out of” хэлц үйл үг нь ямар нэг зүйл бүрэн дуусах гэсэн утгатай: цөлийн дунд машины “petrol” (бензин) дууссан; “ran into” нь санамсаргүй тааралдах гэсэн өөр утгатай.

questions.stem: The match was called ___ because of the snow.
questions.explanation: “call off” нь цуцлах гэсэн утгатай хэлц үйл үг; “because of the snow” гэсэн шалтгаанаар тэмцээн цуцлагдсан тул “was called off” болно.

questions.stem: I don't know this word, so I'll look it ___ in the dictionary.
questions.explanation: Толь бичгээс үг хайж олохыг “look up” хэлц үйл үгээр илэрхийлдэг бөгөөд төлөөний үг “it” дунд нь орж “look it up” болно; “look after” асрах, “look for” хайх гэсэн утгатай ч “look it for” гэж хэлдэггүй.

questions.stem: He always comes ___ interesting solutions to difficult problems.
questions.explanation: “come up with” хэлц үйл үг нь санаа, шийдэл олж гаргах гэсэн утгатай тул “interesting solutions” гэсэн тусагдахуунтай тохирно; “come across” нь санамсаргүй тааралдах гэсэн өөр утгатай.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Find out the appropriate meaning to the underlined parts (idioms) of the sentences. /3*2=6/

questions.stem: Don't worry about the test. It's <u>a piece of cake</u>.
questions.explanation: “a piece of cake” (бялууны зүсэм) хэвшмэл хэллэг нь маш амархан гэсэн утгатай тул “Very easy”; “Don't worry about the test” гэсэн тайвшруулсан үг үүнийг батална.

questions.stem: I can't remember his name, but it's <u>on the tip of my tongue</u>.

options.C: I don't want to say it

questions.explanation: “on the tip of my tongue” (хэлний минь үзүүрт байна) хэвшмэл хэллэг нь нэрийг санах дөхөөд яг хэлж чадахгүй байгааг илэрхийлдэг тул “I almost remember it”.

questions.stem: When Enkhtuya heard that she had won, she was <u>over the moon</u>.
questions.explanation: “over the moon” хэвшмэл хэллэг нь туйлын их баярласныг илэрхийлдэг; Энхтуяа ялснаа сонсоод “Extremely happy” буюу маш их баярласан.

tasks.title: Conversation
tasks.instructions: Read the conversation and choose the best answer for questions 36-37, and complete blanks 38-40 from the given options. /5*2=10/
tasks.text:
Manager: Good morning, and thank you for coming. We need two assistants for our summer camp this year. Please tell us about yourselves.
Anu: Hello, I'm Anu. I'm studying to be a teacher, and I love working with children. I'm patient and very organized.
Dorj: Hi, I'm Dorj. I'm a university student, and I play basketball and the guitar. I'm energetic and I like trying new things.
Manager: Thank you. Anu, what would you do if a child was homesick?
Anu: I'd talk to the child and keep him or her busy with fun activities. 38. _______
Manager: Good. Dorj, how do you deal with stress?
Dorj: I usually go for a run or play music. 39. _______ It helps me relax.
Manager: And what do you think is the most important thing at a summer camp?
Anu: Safety, of course. Children should always know the rules.
Dorj: Safety, yes, but also fun. 40. _______
Manager: Great answers. We'll let you know by Friday.

questions.stem: What is the conversation about?

options.A: It is about a basketball match.
options.B: It is about choosing a university.
options.C: It is about a homesick child.
options.D: It is about a music lesson.
options.E: It is about an interview for summer camp assistants.

questions.explanation: Менежер “We need two assistants for our summer camp this year” гээд нэр дэвшигчдийг өөрсдийнхөө тухай ярихыг хүссэн тул энэ бол “an interview for summer camp assistants” буюу ажлын ярилцлага.

questions.stem: Dorj is a person who is ___.

options.A: energetic and likes trying new things
options.D: studying to be a teacher and is organized

questions.explanation: Дорж “I'm energetic and I like trying new things” гэж өөрийгөө танилцуулсан тул “energetic and likes trying new things”; харин “studying to be a teacher and is organized” нь Ануг тодорхойлно.

options.C: Usually they feel better after a day or two.

questions.explanation: Ану гэрээ санасан хүүхдийг завгүй байлгана гээд “Usually they feel better after a day or two.” гэж нэмсэн нь логик үргэлжлэл; “I'd send them home immediately” нь хүүхдэд анхаарал тавина гэсэн түүний үгтэй зөрчилдөнө.

options.D: Sometimes I just play my guitar for an hour.

questions.explanation: Дорж стрессээ “I usually go for a run or play music” гэж тайлдаг гээд “It helps me relax” гэж төгссөн тул хөгжмийн санааг үргэлжлүүлсэн “Sometimes I just play my guitar for an hour.” тохирно.

options.A: Children should stay inside all day.
options.C: If children don't enjoy camp, they won't want to come back!

questions.explanation: Дорж “Safety, yes, but also fun” гэж хөгжилтэй байхын ач холбогдлыг онцолсон тул шалтгааныг нь тайлбарласан “If children don't enjoy camp, they won't want to come back!” орно.

tasks.title: Reading
tasks.instructions: Read the text and choose the best answers. /6*2=12/
tasks.passageTitle: How can you stay safe during a thunderstorm?
tasks.text:
Thunderstorms happen in every part of the world, and they are especially common in summer. Lightning is a giant spark of electricity between the clouds and the ground. It is extremely hot, several times hotter than the surface of the sun, and it often strikes the highest object in an area.

If you are outdoors when a storm comes …
• Go inside a building or a car with a metal roof as quickly as possible.
• Stay away from tall trees, poles and open fields. Never stand under a lone tree.
• If you are swimming, get out of the water immediately.

If you are inside …
• Stay away from windows and doors.
• Don't use electrical equipment that is plugged into the wall, and avoid taking a shower or bath.
• If you are in a car, keep the windows closed and stay in **<u>it</u>** until the storm has passed.

Remember the 30-30 rule: if you hear thunder less than 30 seconds after you see lightning, go inside, and wait 30 minutes after the last thunder before going back outside.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the text?
questions.explanation: Эх нь аянга цахилгаантай үед юу хийхийг “Go inside…”, “Stay away from…” гэх мэт тушаах хэлбэрийн өгүүлбэрээр зааварласан тул гол зорилго нь “Giving advice” (зөвлөгөө өгөх).

questions.stem: According to the text, lightning often strikes ___.

options.D: the highest object in an area

questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд аянга “often strikes the highest object in an area” гэж бичсэн тул ил задгай газрын ганц мод, өндөр шон хамгийн аюултай.

questions.stem: Lightning is ___.
questions.explanation: Эхний догол мөрөнд “Lightning is a giant spark of electricity between the clouds and the ground” гэж тодорхойлсон; аянга нарны гадаргаас ч халуун тул “colder than the sun” буруу.

questions.stem: The pronoun it in bold and underlined in the text refers to ___.
questions.explanation: “If you are in a car, keep the windows closed and stay in it until the storm has passed” өгүүлбэрт “it” нь мөн өгүүлбэрт дурдсан машиныг, өөрөөр хэлбэл “the car” гэдгийг заана.

questions.stem: According to the text, which of the following is not true?
questions.explanation: Эхэд “Never stand under a lone tree” гэж хатуу хориглосон тул “Stand under a lone tree.” гэсэн зөвлөгөө эхтэй зөрчилдөж, үнэн биш болно.

questions.stem: After the last thunder, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Сүүлийн хэсгийн 30-30 дүрэмд “wait 30 minutes after the last thunder before going back outside” гэж заасан нь “wait 30 minutes before going outside” гэсэнтэй утга нэг.

tasks.instructions: Fill in the blanks (a-e) with suitable linking words (1-7). There are two extra items that you don't need to use. /5*1=5/

items.label: a
items.text: I'll call you ……… I arrive at the airport.
items.explanation: “I'll call you … I arrive at the airport” нь нисэх буудалд хүрмэгцээ залгана гэсэн утгатай тул нэг үйл болмогц нөгөө нь болохыг заадаг “as soon as” орно.

items.label: b
items.text: We went to the beach ……… it was cold and cloudy.
items.explanation: Хүйтэн, үүлэрхэг (“it was cold and cloudy”) байсан ч далайн эрэг явсан нь хүлээлттэй зөрсөн хоёр санаа тул эсрэгцлийг илэрхийлэх “although” (хэдийгээр … ч) холбоос үг орно.

items.label: c
items.text: She was reading a book ……… her brother was cooking.
items.explanation: “was reading” ба “was cooking” гэсэн хоёр үйл нэгэн зэрэг үргэлжилж байсан тул “while” (…-ж байх зуур) холбоос үг тохирно.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Wait here … I come back” нь намайг эргэж иртэл хүлээ гэсэн утгатай тул тодорхой мөч хүртэл үргэлжлэхийг заадаг “until” (…-тал) орно.

items.label: e
items.text: I was very tired, ……… I went to bed early.
items.explanation: “I was very tired” нь шалтгаан, “I went to bed early” нь үр дүн тул үр дагаврыг холбодог “so” (тиймээс) орно; “because” бол шалтгааны өмнө тавигддаг.

choices.text: because
although
so
until
while
unless
as soon as

tasks.instructions: Match the words (a-e) with their definitions (1-7). There are two extra items that you don't need to use. /5*1=5/

items.label: a
items.explanation: “A passport” (паспорт) бол гадаад улс руу зорчиход заавал шаардагдах албан ёсны бичиг баримт: “an official document you need to travel to other countries”.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “A suitcase” (чемодан) нь аялахдаа хувцсаа хийж авч явдаг, бариултай том хайрцаг: “a large case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling”.

items.label: c
items.explanation: Жуулчдыг сонирхолтой газруудаар хөтөлж, тайлбар өгдөг хүнийг “A tour guide” (хөтөч) гэнэ: “a person who shows tourists around interesting places”.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Luggage” (ачаа тээш) нь тоологдохгүй нэр үг бөгөөд аялалд авч явах бүх цүнх, чемоданыг нийтэд нь хэлдэг: “all the bags and cases you take on a journey”.

items.label: e
items.explanation: Очсон газраа дурсаж санахын тулд худалдаж авдаг жижиг эд зүйлийг “A souvenir” (дурсгалын зүйл) гэнэ: “something you buy to remember a place you visited”.

choices.text: ……… a person who shows tourists around interesting places.
……… something you buy to remember a place you visited.
……… an official document you need to travel to other countries.
……… all the bags and cases you take on a journey.
……… a large case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.
……… a ticket that lets you get on a plane.
……… a place where travellers can stay for the night.

tasks.instructions: Match the situations (a-e) with the suggestions (1-7). There are two extra items that you don't need to use. /5*1=5/

items.label: a
items.text: My friend forgot my birthday, so I didn't speak to him for a week.
items.explanation: Найз нь төрсөн өдрийг нь мартсан төдийгөөр түүнтэй долоо хоног яриагүй нь хэтэрсэн тул “You shouldn't have stopped talking to him. Maybe he was very busy.” гэсэн зөвлөгөө тохирно; “shouldn't have + III хэлбэр” өнгөрсөн буруу үйлдлийг шүүмжилнэ.

items.label: b
items.text: I left my homework at home and told the teacher my dog ate it.
items.explanation: Гэрийн даалгавраа мартаад багшдаа “my dog ate it” гэж худал шалтаг хэлсэн тул “You should have told the truth.” (үнэнээ хэлэх ёстой байсан) гэсэн зөвлөгөө тохирно.

items.label: c
items.text: I bought a jacket online, but it was too small. I just put it in the cupboard.
items.explanation: Онлайнаар авсан хүрэм “too small” байсан ч шүүгээндээ хийчихсэн тул буцааж, том хэмжээтэйгээр солиулах ёстой байсан: “You should have sent it back and asked for a bigger size.”

items.label: d
items.text: My neighbour's music was very loud at 2 a.m., so I called the police immediately.
items.explanation: Шөнийн 2 цагт хөршийн чанга хөгжмөөс болж шууд цагдаа дуудсан тул эхлээд хаалгыг нь тогшиж эелдгээр хүсэх нь зөв байсан: “You should have knocked on their door and asked them politely first.”

items.label: e
items.text: I saw a classmate cheating in the exam, but I didn't say anything.
items.explanation: Ангийнхаа хүүхэд шалгалтын үеэр хуулж байхыг хараад юу ч хэлээгүй гэж ярьсан хүнд “I would have told the teacher after the exam.” (би бол багшид хэлэх байсан) гэж хариулах нь тохирно; “would have + III хэлбэр” өнгөрсөнд хийх байсан үйлийг илэрхийлнэ.

choices.text: You should have told the truth.
You should have sent it back and asked for a bigger size.
You should have knocked on their door and asked them politely first.
You shouldn't have stopped talking to him. Maybe he was very busy.
I would have told the teacher after the exam.
I would have bought a cake.
You should have studied more.

tasks.instructions: Read the incomplete conversation at a railway station and fill in the gaps with the appropriate parts (1-7). There are two extra items that you don't need to use. /5*1=5/
tasks.text:
Tourist: Excuse me, I'd like a ticket to Erdenet, please.
Clerk: Single or return?
Tourist: Return, please. a. _______
Clerk: It leaves at 8:20 tonight from platform 2.
Tourist: How long does the journey take?
Clerk: b. _______ You'll arrive early tomorrow morning.
Tourist: Great. Can I pay by card?
Clerk: c. _______ That's 45,000 tugriks, please.
Tourist: Here you are. d. _______
Clerk: Yes, there's a small café next to the waiting room.
Tourist: Thank you. e. _______
Clerk: You're welcome. Have a good trip!

items.label: a
items.explanation: Кассын ажилтан “It leaves at 8:20 tonight from platform 2” гэж хөдлөх цагийг хэлсэн тул жуулчин “What time does the next train leave?” гэж асуусан байна.

items.label: b
items.explanation: Жуулчин “How long does the journey take?” гэж хугацаа асуусан тул “About eleven hours.” гэсэн хариу тохирно; орой 8:20-д хөдлөөд маргааш өглөө эрт хүрэх нь ч үүнийг батална.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “Can I pay by card?” гэсэн асуултад ажилтан “Yes, of course.” гэж зөвшөөрөөд “That's 45,000 tugriks, please” гэж үнийг нь хэлж байна; “It's very expensive.” нь асуултад хариулахгүй.

items.label: d
items.explanation: Ажилтан “Yes, there's a small café next to the waiting room” гэж хариулсан тул жуулчин буудалд хоол авах газар байгаа эсэхийг асуусан: “Is there anywhere to buy food at the station?”

items.label: e
items.explanation: Ажилтан “You're welcome” гэж хариулсан тул өмнө нь жуулчин талархлаа илэрхийлсэн байх ёстой: “Thank you” гээд “You've been very helpful.” (та их тус боллоо) гэж нэмжээ.

choices.text: Is there anywhere to buy food at the station?
What time does the next train leave?
About eleven hours.
Yes, of course.
You've been very helpful.
It's very expensive.
No, it's on platform 5.
